name: Gobuddy – The official Gobuddy add-on for WooCommerce
author: Gobuddy

sections.description:
Gobuddy connects your WooCommerce store to a hybrid delivery network — eleven national courier partners plus a community transporter network that reaches the addresses couriers usually decline.

Install the plugin, connect your store, and every paid order flows straight into your Gobuddy dashboard. You compare live rates across couriers, generate a waybill, and track the parcel to the door — without paying a monthly subscription fee. Only pay for the deliveries you do.

Why retailers use Gobuddy

No subscription. No setup fee. No lock-in.
The platform is free. You pay per delivery, at negotiated courier rates. There is no monthly platform charge, no per-integration charge, and no contract to exit. Get going in minutes.

Eleven couriers, one integration.
Stop maintaining a separate account, login and rate card for each courier. Gobuddy aggregates them behind a single checkout, a single dashboard and a single invoice.

Deliver where you currently cannot.
A large share of South African delivery addresses sit in townships, peri-urban settlements and rural towns that traditional couriers either refuse or surcharge heavily. Gobuddy’s community transporter network covers them. For many merchants this is the difference between a checkout that converts and a checkout that shows “delivery unavailable in your area”.

Same-day where it matters.
Local orders within 20km can be matched to a nearby community transporter and delivered the same day, typically before 18:00.

Tracking your customers can see.
You receive live status updates for every order displayed on your dashboard. You get confirmation emails for dispatches and delivery complete. Your customer gets WhatsApp updates for statuses of the delivery.

What the plugin does

The plugin syncs paid WooCommerce orders to your Gobuddy dashboard automatically — no CSV uploads, no manual capture.

Your Gobuddy Dashboard then:

  • Returns live delivery quotes across the courier network and the community network
  • Recommends the most suitable option by destination, parcel weight, urgency and past courier performance
  • Generates waybills, statements and invoices
  • Sends tracking notifications to your customer by email and WhatsApp
  • Handles returns and one-click collections
  • Supports multiple users and multiple store integrations on one Gobuddy account

How the delivery network works

Gobuddy is a hybrid network. Every order is offered to the option that actually serves that address best:

  1. Community transporters — verified local transporters already travelling that route, on foot, by bicycle, scooter, car or public transport. Best for same-day, hyper-local and township delivery.
  2. National courier partners — for long-haul, bulk, and destinations outside community coverage.

If no community transporter is available for a given delivery, the order is routed to a courier partner automatically. Nothing stalls, and nothing needs your intervention.

Courier partners in the network:

  • RTT Logistics
  • Courier IT
  • RAM Hand-to-Hand Couriers
  • Internet Express
  • City Sprint
  • TFS
  • Fastway
  • Aramex
  • Skynet
  • The Courier Guy
  • Pudo

Who it is for

Online stores, D2C brands, pharmacies, grocers, marketplaces, subscription businesses and independent sellers — anywhere in South Africa, shipping from one order a week to ten thousand a month.

External Services

This plugin connects to the following external services.

1. Gobuddy Dashboard — https://app.gobuddy.net

What it is: Your web portal to send shipments, compare courier costs, print waybills and track parcels.

2. Gobuddy API — https://api-v2.gobuddy.net

What it is: The Gobuddy delivery platform. This is the service the plugin exists to connect to; the plugin does not function without it.

When data is sent: When you request a delivery quote, when a WooCommerce order is synced for fulfilment, when a waybill is generated, and when delivery status is retrieved for an order.

Data sent: WooCommerce order ID and order status; recipient name, delivery address and contact details; collection address; parcel weight and dimensions; delivery instructions or notes; and the store credentials you enter during setup (Gobuddy Client ID and Secret ID, WooCommerce Consumer Key and Consumer Secret) for authentication.

Why it is sent: To price the delivery, allocate a transporter or courier, produce the waybill, and return tracking information to your Gobuddy dashboard.

Onward sharing: Gobuddy shares the recipient name, contact number, delivery address and parcel identifier with the courier or transporter allocated to that specific delivery, solely so the parcel can be delivered. Partners are contractually bound to equivalent POPIA-compliant standards. No delivery data is sold, and none is shared for marketing.

Data controller and location: Gobuddy Network (Pty) Ltd, South Africa. Delivery records are retained for a minimum of five years as required by the Electronic Communications and Transactions Act.

Terms and privacy:

  • Gobuddy Terms of Use
  • Gobuddy Privacy Policy

Your obligations as the site owner: You are the responsible party for your customers’ personal information. You must disclose in your own privacy policy that order and delivery data is transmitted to Gobuddy for fulfilment, and obtain any consent required under POPIA, the GDPR, or other law that applies to you. Under POPIA, Gobuddy acts as your Operator and processes end-customer data only on your instruction.

Configuration: Data is transmitted only after you have entered valid Gobuddy credentials and activated the integration. An unconfigured plugin sends nothing.

2. WordPress.org Plugin API — https://api.wordpress.org/

What it is: The standard WordPress update-check endpoint.

Data sent: The plugin slug and installed version number only. No personal data, order data or site-identifying data.

Why it is sent: To notify you when a plugin update is available.

Privacy: WordPress.org Privacy Policy.

Configuration: Automatic and non-configurable — this is core WordPress update behaviour.
sections.installation:
1. In your WordPress dashboard, go to Plugins → Add New, search for Gobuddy, install and activate.
  2. Register your business free at app.gobuddy.net.
  3. In WordPress, go to Gobuddy → Dashboard → Account Connection and enter the merchant email address you used to register in the previous step
  4. Click “Send OTP” and wait for the confirmation email to be sent to your email address
  5. Enter the OTP and click “Verify OTP”. Your account should now be connected

Your store is connected. Orders sync from that point forward.

Setup support: support@gobuddy.net or 071 677 6669.
sections.faq:
Does the plugin cost anything?

No. There is no licence fee, setup fee or monthly subscription. You pay only for the deliveries you dispatch.

Do I need a Gobuddy account?

Yes. The plugin is the WooCommerce connector for the Gobuddy platform. Registration at (https://gobuddy.net/get-started) is free.

Which couriers can I ship with?

RTT Logistics, Courier IT, RAM Hand-to-Hand Couriers, Internet Express, City Sprint, TFS, Fastway, Aramex, Skynet, The Courier Guy and Pudo — plus the Gobuddy community transporter network.

Can I choose the courier myself?

Yes. Gobuddy recommends an option, but the choice is always yours. You can also set defaults per delivery type.

How fast is delivery?

If the delivery distance is hyper-local then you will get same-day delivery options, typically before 18:00 if picked up before 10h00. How we do this is to match deliveries to community transporters and on-demand delivery services. For conventional traditional courier options, each courier has multiple service levels you can choose from, Economy can range from three to five business days, but express and overnight options are available.

What happens if my preferred courier is unavailable?

Gobuddy automatically offers the next best available option. Deliveries do not stall waiting for one carrier. You get instant courier and price discovery.

Does it work outside major cities?

Yes. The network covers all nine provinces, including townships, peri-urban areas and rural towns that most couriers surcharge or decline.

Is tracking extra?

No. Tracking is included on every delivery, with a branded tracking page available at no charge.

Do I need a developer?

No. Installation is only a few steps and takes a few minutes.

Can I use this alongside my existing courier account?

Yes. Gobuddy runs as an additional shipping method at checkout. Your existing WooCommerce shipping options continue to work unchanged.
